# Maxor

**Time Limit:** `1000 ms`  
**Memory Limit:** `256 MB`  
**Source:** [https://csacademy.com/contest/archive/task/maxor/](https://csacademy.com/contest/archive/task/maxor/)  

---

You are given an array $A$ of $N$ integers. Find the maximum bitwise or value of any two elements of $A$ and the number of pairs that generate this value.

### Standard input

The first line contains a single integer $N$.

The second line contains $N$ integers representing the elements of $A$.

### Standard output

Print two integers on the first line. The first value should be the maximum bitwise or, and the second value the number of pairs.

### Constraints and notes

$2 \leq N \leq 10^5$ $0 \leq A_i < 2^{17}$
